race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Only a handful make any serious appeal in this big-field novice, EL RA'ADY taken to make a successful debut for powerful connections. Nip About built on his debut promise returned to a more suitable trip when runner-up over C&D and he may have to settle for silver again, with Big Money and stable-switcher Janora taken to fight out third. EL RA'ADY (IRE) NIP ABOUT BIG MONEY
race.bettingForecast: Big Money (13/8), El Ra'ady (5/2), Nip About (4/1), Janora (12/1), Win Or Lose (14/1), Veronique (14/1), Savernake (20/1), Ezenli (25/1), Momotombo (33/1), Elsy D (50/1), Wind The Bobbin Up (50/1), Casement Park (66/1), Medran (66/1)
